events.title: Liquidation of the Bialystok ghetto
events.summary: Liquidation of the Bialystok ghetto began on August 16, 1943.
events.uncertaintyNote: The end date is based on the stated continuation of sporadic resistance until September 16, 1943.

evidence.quote:
The liquidation of the Bialystok ghetto began on
August 16, 1943
evidence.modelQuote: The liquidation of the Bialystok ghetto began on August 16, 1943

events.title: Selection and massacre at Pietrasze Field
events.summary: Gestapo officers selected Jews for forced labor or killing at Pietrasze Field.

evidence.quote:
In the next four hours, some 3,000
people were removed from Pietrasze Field

events.title: Deportation from the ghetto to Treblinka
events.summary: Jews deemed unfit for work were transported to Treblinka and killed.

evidence.quote:
Those Jews at Pietrasze Field deemed unfit for
work were transported to the railroad station

events.title: February action in the Bialystok ghetto
events.summary: Nazi massacre and searches continued from February 5 to 12, 1943.

evidence.quote:
The massacre continued for seven days from Feb-
ruary 5-12, 1943

events.title: Order to remove 12,000 Jews
events.summary: The Gestapo ordered the Judenrat to arrange removal of 12,000 Jews in 1941.

evidence.quote:
the Judenrat received an order from the Gestapo
